verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI documents real-browser crawling across Chromium, Firefox and WebKit. It also executes JS, waits for async content and simulates scrolling to load dynamic content, which covers SPA rendering. However, the evidence only shows markdown or extracted output and never explicitly documents returning the fully rendered HTML. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of rendered-HTML output, independent or hands-on corroboration of SPA rendering.

support.subject: As a developer, I can render JavaScript-heavy single-page applications and get the fully rendered HTML

citations.quote: Dynamic Crawling: Execute JS and wait for async or sync for dynamic content extraction.
Full-Page Scanning: Simulates scrolling to load and capture all dynamic content, perfect for infinite scroll pages.
Multi-Browser Support: Compatible with Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit.
